App Overview
Tired of figuring out team combinations every time?
Whether it's for sports, shuffle lunches, workshops, or seating arrangements—Teamru makes team assignment effortless.

Perfect for:

Sports and board games

Study groups and workshops

Shuffle lunches and office events

Parties and seating plans

Key Features:

Save Frequent Groups
Register up to 5 groups in advance to skip repeated input.

Simple, Fast Operation
Create teams in just 3 steps—no complex setup needed.

Shuffle Again Anytime
Re-shuffle teams instantly on the result screen.

Share Results Easily
Displayed in a clean, shareable list format with just one tap.

Flexible Teaming Options
Support for up to 100 people and 100 teams. Add custom notes to results.

Privacy-Friendly
No data is transmitted. All processing is done on your device.

How to Use:

Create and save your groups.

Select a group or enter members manually.

Choose the number of teams (or set custom names).

Use it for any group activity where fair, fast team generation is needed.
Try Teamru today and simplify your team-making process!
